actualTrackingIssueTitle: [AutoPerf F122] Concrete enumerator pattern: no established production consumer
actualTrackingIssueBody:
## Outcome

**F122 is rejected for production fit, not a numerical no-gain result.** No shipping source candidate or performance comparison was selected. A new concrete-only struct-enumerator pattern cannot be selected through the inspected ControllerContext/PageContext IList properties; the fourteen-module MVC cohorts establish only nongeneric self-forwarding to concrete GetEnumerator. This is bounded evidence, not a whole-repository/dynamic absence proof.

One original-only profile completed all 32 cases / 256 retained observations. The real original copied-five-factory generic loop reports 30.54 ns/op and 40 B/op; untouched-five reports 52.23 ns/op and 32 B/op. These are not change improvements or an allocation-free claim. A broader interface-path redesign is not ruled out.

actualIndependentProjectReproduction.actualExcludedBuildBoundaries: The exact common project is rebuilt. Its consumers retain the frozen source-built owner/dependency images; this does not repeat full framework, compiled Razor Page, packaging or repository builds.

actualEvaluation.actualReason: The original interface-returning GetEnumerator is a real syntactic fact, but the inspected controller/page public properties expose IList<IValueProviderFactory>. The 14-module MVC IL cohorts establish four constructor operands and only the owner non-generic forwarding call to its concrete GetEnumerator. A new concrete struct-enumerator pattern alone is not selectable through those properties. The predeclared production-fit gate was not met, so no shipping candidate or performance comparison was selected.
actualEvaluation.actualOriginalInterfaceCostReading: The actual original copied-five-factory generic interface loop reports 40 B/op; the untouched-five-factory loop reports 32 B/op. These are absolute original observations, not a candidate improvement or a refutation of all possible interface-path redesigns.
actualEvaluation.actualSourceBranchPurpose: Preserve the twelve passing enumeration contract rows on an independent tests-only branch; the shipping owner remains unchanged.
